description: This file contains preview composable functions for the HomeScreen and FeaturedBanner in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It sets up sample data for UI previews, including tabs, featured media items, and genre rows.

methods.name: HomeScreenPreview
methods.description: Provides a composable preview of the HomeScreen with sample data including tabs, featured media, and genre rows.

methods.name: FeaturedBannerPreview
methods.description: Provides a composable preview of the FeaturedBanner with sample featured media item.
